I inspected the entity (--top 1 --json, full field dump) and reconstructed the receipt total from its actual components: CashSum + TransferSum + BillOfExchangeAmount + sum(PaymentChecks[].CheckSum) + sum(PaymentCreditCards[].CreditSum), pulled with --all --page-size 200 across all 373 rows. That reconstruction returned exactly 661235553.89 and the identical 64/309 split, matching HANA's ORCT.DocTotal to the paisa. (c) Bank-row trap quantified in HANA with a CASE split on CardCode prefix (CUST/VEND/ORG => BP_ROWS, else GL_ACCT_ROWS) and independently in Python via CardCode.isdigit() — both gave 309/Rs 406,989,609.69 BP and 64/Rs 254,245,944.20 G/L.
